# Finbharat

Finbharat is building thoughtful technology for a more understandable and inclusive financial future for people across India.

Company: Finbharat Technology Private Limited.
Tagline: Building wealth, Strengthening Bharat.
Mission (an ambition): To democratize wealth creation for the next 100 million Indians by making financial participation simple, accessible and inclusive.

## Cofounders

- D. Ramanathan, CFP CM: cofounder, Managing Director & CEO, Greater Chennai Area. https://www.linkedin.com/in/d-ramanathan-cfp-cm-791b151b/
- Rakesh K: cofounder, IIMC alumnus, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. https://www.linkedin.com/in/rakeshkgogetter/

Founder information was supplied by the website owner. Founder portraits were supplied by the website owner.

## Audience and direction

The direction considers different regions and languages, income levels, abilities, access needs, digital confidence, and both first-time and experienced investors. Design principles include clarity, trust, privacy, accessibility and human agency.

## Website calculators

- /mutual-funds/: educational mutual fund explanations and an embedded SIP calculator.
- /fixed-deposits/: educational fixed deposit explanations and an embedded FD calculator.
- /inclusion/: inclusion principles.
- /about/: company purpose and cofounder profiles.
- /blog/: published editorial articles.
- /media/: published announcements, attributed coverage and videos.
- /calculators/fd/: compound-interest fixed deposit calculator.
- /calculators/sip/: beginning-of-month SIP calculator with optional initial investment.
- /calculators/goal/: inflation-adjusted goal calculator with current savings, monthly contribution estimate and an alternative additional one-time investment.

Calculators run in the browser using user-provided assumptions. Results are illustrative and not financial advice. Actual returns, rates, taxes and outcomes may vary.
